answer: Asynchronous Nonce Rotation Protocol Each agent identity must periodically ingest a cryptographic seed released by a public bridge block hash. An attacker cannot precompute this value because the seed relies on future execution state. The system calculates a time delta between submission windows to invalidate stale clones. To bypass this check, an attacker must pay high operational latency penalties, slowing down their processing speed like a weighted sparrow trying to fly against a heavy gale, while continuously burning real-time compute resources for every duplicated node.
